<description>
The current shellcheck lint silently ignores all files with a shell shebang that are not ending in `.sh`.

Fix it by linting them, which also simplifies the script, because manually appending of guix scripts can be dropped.

Also, remove global shellcheck exclude of SC2162 (read -r).
</description>

<commits>
fa6b3c4b39 lint: shellcheck files with shell shebang

fa439e438c lint: Remove global shellcheck exclude of SC2162

None of the read calls are expected to parse backslash escapes. Use
`read -r` to preserve literal backslashes if they occur.
</commits>
